angellist-angellist:lever:7ac9e5b8-45f3-.title: Strategic Finance Lead - GTM & Product
angellist-angellist:lever:7ac9e5b8-45f3-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role: Nova is AngelList's banking and payments network for private markets. Funds and investors both live on the network, and money (subscriptions, capital calls, distributions) moves between them inside it instead of through wires and PDFs. On top of those rails sits a growing menu of financial products: treasury and yield, credit, and a wealth layer that keeps an investor's capital working from one fund to the next. We're looking for someone to own the economics of that product menu with the autonomy and scope of a division CFO. Your fingerprints should be visible on which products we build, how they're priced, and how fast they reach the market. This is not a traditional finance role. Success is whether the business makes better decisions, ships the right products, and accelerates revenue.
responsibilities: Own the Nova business narrative on financial performance, product economics, and outlook, including mastery of the Nova P&L and revenue model.
Own the economics of the financial-product menu (deposits, treasury, payments, credit, and wealth) and bring the point of view on what to build next, how it is priced, and how it makes money.

Drive revenue growth: own target-setting and go-to-market planning for new and existing products, and unlock adoption across every channel from direct GP sales, the Ark / fund-admin cross-sell to the LP surface.
Model the unit economics that drive the call (NIM and float, lending spread and risk, referral and take-rate economics, AUM fees), and connect each product to payments volume, balances, and revenue.

farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:66f49027-21.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. OPERATIONS The Operations team serves as the backbone of our marketplace, seamlessly managing the entire order journey. From creating online content and ensuring secure payments to order fulfillment and delivery, while providing comprehensive customer and partner care, this team is relentlessly focused on improving the customer experience every single day. LONDON Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events. THE ROLE As a Translator (Product Information) for Japanese, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring Farfetch’s product catalogue and all related materials resonate with local audiences. Reporting directly to the LangOps & Development team, your primary responsibility will be localising diverse content types with a strong focus on product information, including materials, compositions, and size & fit details. Additionally, you will manage translation workflows, translation memories, and terminology databases to ensure quality and consistency across all platforms. You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of Farfetch’s localisation processes, ensuring a seamless customer experience while maintaining our distinctive tone of voice. Translate and localise product information, including detailed descriptions of materials, fabric compositions, and size & fit elements, ensuring clarity and accuracy for local audiences; Localise and adapt FARFETCH’s product catalogue and associated content, tailoring the language to meet the cultural nuances and preferences of the target audience; Manage translation workflows, ensuring projects are delivered on time and meet the highest quality standards; Manage and maintain translation memories and terminology databases, ensuring consistency across all translated materials and optimising reuse of existing translations; Review and clean up outdated or inaccurate copy, ensuring the product catalogue remains up-to-date, accurate, and aligned with luxury fashion standards; Participate in company-wide initiatives to improve and optimise translation processes, content quality, and workflows for the product catalogue; Ensure consistency in language and tone of voice across all channels, including website content, product descriptions, marketing campaigns, emails, and social media; Collaborate with the larger multilingual team to align on best practices for localisation and maintain high-quality standards; Utilise and contribute to the development of cutting-edge localisation tools and technology to streamline processes and improve accuracy; Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance the quality and efficiency of the translation process. Language Expert: Native-level fluency in Japanese, with exceptional written and verbal skills; Luxury E-commerce Experience: Proven experience in writing, translating, and localising content for luxury or high-end e-commerce brands. Experience in translating technical product details such as fabric compositions, material properties, and size & fit elements is highly desired; Cultural Sensitivity: Ability to craft compelling, customer-centric content that engages and appeals to the tastes and preferences of local audiences; Process-Oriented: Experience in managing translation workflows, using translation memories, and maintaining terminology databases to ensure content

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Intellectual Property Technology Specialist
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Technical Specialist – Small Molecule Intellectual Property The Company Montai Therapeutics is a privately held, biotechnology company focused on harnessing AI to decode untapped diverse chemistry to develop breakthrough oral medicines that can address persistent unmet needs in chronic disease. With our CONECTA® platform, Montai has built the world’s leading foundation models for decoding the complex language between nature’s bioactive chemistry and human biology – supercharging the drug discovery process with unprecedented optionality and predictability. The Role We are looking for a highly motivated, detailed-oriented and personable team player to join our Intellectual Property team as a Technical Specialist. This role will support the development and execution of the company’s intellectual property strategy for small molecule drug discovery programs and innovative biotech AI. Working closely with patent counsel, medicinal chemists, biologists, and external patent attorneys, the Technical Specialist will assist with invention harvesting, patent drafting, prior art analyses, competitive intelligence, and IP AI tool design and implementation. This position is ideal for an early-career scientist with a strong background in organic or medicinal chemistry who is interested in intellectual property. The successful candidate will receive mentoring and on-the-job training in patent law and patent practice, with the opportunity to develop toward becoming a registered U.S. Patent Agent. No prior IP experience is required. Responsibilities Collaborate with research teams to identify patentable inventions and support invention disclosure activities. Assist in preparing patent applications, including drafting technical descriptions, examples, compound tables, figures, and supporting documentation. Review patent applications, Office Action responses, and other patent documents prepared by outside counsel for technical accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Conduct literature and patent prior art searches using commercial and public databases. Monitor competitor's patent filings, scientific publications, conferences, and emerging technologies to identify competitive developments and potential collaboration or licensing opportunities. Assist with preparation of presentations and reports for senior management and cross-functional teams. Support implementation of AI-enabled tools and workflows for data gathering/QC and Markush claim drafting. Basic Qualifications B.S., in Organic Chemistry or Medicinal Chemistry. 1–2 years of experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or related scientific setting. Strong working knowledge of small molecule chemistry, structure, and nomenclature. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proficiency in ChemDraw, Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, including organizing and analyzing technical data. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn about intellectual property, AI tools, new technologies, and scientific disciplines. Preferred M.S. or Ph.D. in related field Experience preparing invention disclosures or supporting patent applications. Familiarity with U.S. patent law and international patent systems. Experience using patent databases such as SciFinder, USPTO, WIPO, Espacenet, and Google Patents. Familiarity with chemical structure searching and Markush analysis. Eligibility to sit for the USPTO Patent Bar and interest in pursuing registration as a U.S. Patent Agent. jobgether-jobgether:lever:221d868d-d671-.title: Vendor Security & Standards Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:221d868d-d671-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vendor Security & Standards Manager based in Switzerland. This is a senior global security role focused on ensuring external supply chain partners consistently meet rigorous security standards. You will own vendor security requirements across carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, and last-mile providers. The role combines standards ownership, physical compliance inspections, corrective action management, and vendor performance oversight. You will operate across multiple international regions, identifying security gaps and driving measurable improvements across a complex vendor network. Success requires a firm, independent approach and the ability to hold vendors accountable while building effective working relationships. The position offers significant exposure to global supply chain security, critical infrastructure, and rapidly evolving technology environments. Extensive international travel will be an important part of the role, with occasional availability required for urgent compliance matters. Own and continuously improve the global vendor security standards framework, ensuring requirements remain comprehensive, current, enforceable, and aligned with relevant policies and industry best practices. Establish and enforce clear security compliance expectations for carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, last-mile providers, and other external supply chain partners. Ensure vendors formally accept applicable security requirements before beginning operational activities and work with legal and procurement teams to embed these obligations into contracts and service agreements. Conduct scheduled and unannounced physical inspections at vendor facilities, transit locations, and operational sites across international regions. Verify controls such as access management, personnel screening, CCTV, handling procedures, tamper-evident measures, and chain-of-custody processes against established standards, including TAPA FSR and TAPA TSR where applicable. Produce detailed inspection reports, document compliance gaps, identify systemic risks, and provide practical recommendations for remediation. Issue corrective action requirements to non-compliant vendors, establish binding remediation timelines, and track outstanding actions through to verified resolution. Conduct follow-up inspections to confirm that corrective measures have been implemented effectively and sustainably. Maintain an accurate global vendor compliance register covering inspection history, corrective actions, risk exposure, and current compliance status. Escalate persistent or serious non-compliance and recommend appropriate measures, including sanctions, suspension, or vendor replacement when necessary. Act as the primary security compliance contact for external vendors, communicating expectations clearly and assertively to security and operational leadership. Conduct structured vendor security reviews, support new-vendor assessments, and define security requirements that must be met before operational activation. Prepare global compliance reports for leadership, identify recurring patterns across vendors or regions, and recommend improvements to standards, policies, procedures, and enforcement mechanisms. Work closely with regional security teams across the USA, EU, Taiwan, APAC, Israel, and future operating regions to maintain consistent security expectations and enforcement. Requirements Significant professional experience in supply chain security compliance, vendor auditing, physical security, or security standards enforcement. Proven experience conducting physical security inspections and compliance assessments across complex, multi-vendor or international environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5fa80eda-a941-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Ireland. This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins. 2

jobgether-jobgether:lever:64589b97-8bdb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Developer Platform based in United States. This is a high-impact staff-level engineering role focused on building the internal platform that enables developers to ship secure software at scale. You’ll own significant areas across monorepo CI/CD, shared build infrastructure, and agentic AI tooling. The role combines deep technical execution with architectural leadership, platform strategy, and cross-functional influence. You’ll help reduce developer toil, improve delivery velocity, and create reliable, standardized paths from code changes to production. A major focus will be evolving engineering workflows to support AI-driven development while maintaining strong validation, security, and review standards. You’ll work closely with engineers across the organization, treating internal teams as platform customers and using data to improve their experience. This opportunity is ideal for a self-directed technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, and wants to shape the future of developer platforms. Own significant components of the Developer Platform, including monorepo CI/CD, agentic AI infrastructure, shared build systems, and related developer tooling. Define and influence technical direction by evaluating architectural tradeoffs, documenting designs, and aligning multiple engineering teams around scalable target architectures. Improve the speed, reliability, and developer experience of CI/CD pipelines so engineering teams can spend more time delivering software and less time troubleshooting builds. Help develop next-generation change workflows that extend beyond traditional pull-request models, including automated validation, trusted agent-driven changes, AI-assisted review, and safe auto-merge capabilities. Productionize agentic AI capabilities through observability, structured tracing, cost monitoring, debuggability, shared memory, and context-engineering patterns such as skills, tools, and memory. Consolidate fragmented build systems and create standardized platform blueprints that enable products to onboard quickly and move reliably into production. Partner with engineers across the organization to identify recurring sources of toil, automate manual processes, and anticipate developer needs before they become operational bottlenecks. Develop technical architecture documents that address reliability, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Establish and improve developer productivity practices using metrics such as DORA and SPACE to measure engineering velocity and operational effectiveness. Mentor engineers, raise standards for system design and code reviews, and contribute as a senior technical voice across the engineering organization. Build stakeholder feedback loops and use internal engineering teams as customers to continuously improve platform capabilities and adoption. Requirements 8+ years of experience building and operating production services and platform infrastructure in modern cloud environments. Strong proficiency in Go (Golang), or demonstrated ability and willingness to ramp up quickly. Deep expertise in CI/CD systems, container-based orchestration, and the tooling required to operate large monorepos across build, test, and release workflows. Experience influencing technical direction across multiple engineering teams, including evaluating tradeoffs, retiring legacy systems, and establishing alignment around target architectures. Familiarity with production-grade Agentic AI or LLM-based automation, with an interest in context engineering, RAG, memory, and tool-calling at engineering-platform scale. Strong understanding of developer experience and engineering productivity, ideally including DORA or SPACE metrics and related instrumentation. Excellent communication and collaboration

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6525e2ec-8d3c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Project Coordinator based in Mexico. This freelance opportunity is ideal for an organized marketing professional who enjoys coordinating projects and keeping teams aligned. You will support marketing campaigns, launches, brand initiatives, and day-to-day project operations from planning through delivery. The role combines project coordination, social media knowledge, stakeholder communication, and detailed task management. You will collaborate with creative, digital, product, and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic remote environment. Your work will help ensure projects stay on schedule, risks are identified early, and deliverables meet expectations. The position offers flexibility, professional development, and the opportunity to contribute to a variety of marketing projects. With approximately 15 hours per week, it can suit professionals seeking a flexible freelance engagement alongside other commitments. Assist with planning and executing marketing campaigns, product launches, and brand initiatives from kickoff through completion. Coordinate project timelines, plans, task trackers, milestones, and deliverables to keep stakeholders aligned. Support social media-related marketing activities and coordinate associated assets and approvals. Schedule and facilitate project meetings, prepare agendas, document discussions, and follow up on action items. Monitor project progress, identify potential risks or blockers, and escalate issues to relevant project or department leads. Act as a communication link between internal and cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth project execution. Coordinate the delivery, review, and approval of marketing assets across relevant stakeholders. Track team capacity and workloads to support resource planning across active projects. Maintain organized project documentation, including briefs, status reports, templates, process documentation, and post-project reviews. Prepare and distribute regular project status updates to stakeholders. Assist with tracking project budgets and identifying potential variances. Provide additional marketing and project coordination support as needed to help achieve team objectives. Requirements: Previous experience in marketing support, project coordination, project management, or a related field; experience levels from junior to senior may be considered. Demonstrated social media experience is required. Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly in a remote, cross-functional environment. Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, Trello, or comparable tools. Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, deadlines, and project requirements. qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:5d606797-9464-4780.description: Mechanical Design Engineer (Entry Level) Location: Chesterfield, VA Schedule: 9/80 schedule (every other Friday off) Job Type: Direct Hire Starting Salary: $80,000/year (Higher salary available based on experience) Travel: Approximately 10% Position Overview Seeking a hands-on Mechanical Design Engineer to design, improve, and support specialized heavy equipment and mechanical systems. This role covers the full product lifecycle—from concept and engineering through manufacturing, field deployment, testing, and ongoing improvement. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex mechanical problems and working directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, vendors, and customers.
responsibilities: Mechanical Design & Development
Design new crane systems and modify existing equipment.
Develop practical mechanical solutions, including reverse engineering and redesign of existing components.
Use CAD modeling, engineering calculations, FEA, prototyping, and field testing to validate designs.
Improve equipment performance, manufacturability, serviceability, reliability, and cost.
Maintain and improve standard equipment designs while meeting engineering standards, customer requirements, and safety regulations.
Project & Production Support
Manage engineering projects from concept through manufacturing, testing, implementation, and lifecycle support.

Verify equipment meets customer specifications, engineering standards, and regulatory requirements.
Engineering Support
Apply engineering judgment and creative problem-solving to technical challenges.
Maintain engineering documentation, calculations, drawings, bills of materials (BOMs) , and design records.
Communicate technical information effectively with customers, vendors, manufacturing teams, and other departments.
Support quality, product standardization, and continuous improvement efforts.
Manage multiple projects and changing priorities, including emergency response needs.
Maintain knowledge of company products, industry standards, and engineering practices.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

rapp-rapp:greenhouse:7567433.title: Community Manager (Executive)
rapp-rapp:greenhouse:7567433.description: RAPP Dubai is looking for a Community Manager (Executive) to join our award-winning Experience Strategy team. WHO WE ARE: We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale. As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations. We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being. HOW WE DO IT: At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning. Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients. Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets. YOUR ROLE: RAPP MENA is seeking a Community Manager (Executive) to support day-to-day community management and social customer support across multiple social platforms for a large enterprise account. The role is responsible for managing high-volume brand interactions, supporting always-on and campaign activity, and delivering timely, on-brand responses aligned with agreed SLAs, governance, and client standards. This role requires bilingual communication skills (Arabic & English) and the ability to operate within a structured, SLA-driven environment. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: Manage daily community engagement and social customer support across assigned platforms Respond to comments, direct messages, and customer queries in line with agreed SLAs, tone of voice, and escalation protocols Moderate conversations, identify risks, complaints, or sensitive issues, and escalate where required Support always-on social activity and campaign launches with timely, real-time engagement Coordinate with internal social, content, and account teams to resolve customer issues Track recurring questions, sentiment, and emerging community trends, sharing insights with relevant teams Follow defined governance processes, approval workflows, and platform best practices Ensure consistent quality, accuracy, and responsiveness across all community interactions REQUIRED SKILLS: 1–3 years’ experience in community management, social media, or social customer support roles Experience supporting enterprise or high-volume accounts Strong understanding of major social platforms and customer engagement best practices Written communication skills ( Arabic required; English essential ) Comfortable managing customer-facing interactions in a structured, process-driven environment Organized, reliable, and able to work independently within defined SLAs and workflows Hands-on experience using community management, moderation, or social support tools (e.g. Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Emplify, or similar platforms) Ability to adapt quickly to new tools and reporting workflows used by the agency or client Our Hybrid Work Model: RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like. NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

southparkcommons-socket:ashbyhq:09d8b0c5.title: VP of Engineering
southparkcommons-socket:ashbyhq:09d8b0c5.description: About Us Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets https://socket.dev/love to see for yourself!) Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh https://www.linkedin.com/in/feross/, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ https://socket.dev/blog/series-b125M in funding https://socket.dev/blog/series-c from top angels, operators, and security leaders. A Letter From Our Founder & CEO: We've built something rare at Socket. A 40-person engineering team that moves with velocity and keeps a high bar on what ships. We don't have the usual dysfunction that plagues fast-growing companies. What we do have is clarity about the problem we're solving, alignment on what matters, and people who care about doing work that actually protects the software supply chain. Now we're at an interesting inflection point. We need to double the engineering organization while keeping everything that made us fast. That's the core problem: how do you stay fast and maintain code quality and culture while you scale from 40 to 80+ engineers? The best engineering organizations don't scale because they hire more of the right people. They scale because they've designed how decisions get made, how work gets prioritized, how teams coordinate without creating meetings overhead, how people get unblocked. The operating system is the difference between a team that grows and a team that fractures under its own weight. Socket has a strong technical leadership team. What we're missing is someone who owns the operating system. Someone who looks at how we're currently shipping things and says "this works for 40 people, but it won't work for 80, and here's what we need to change. Someone who understands that keeping engineers happy and keeping the product moving fast are the same problem, not competing problems. This role is about protecting what we've built while scaling it. It's about designing planning processes and team structure and decision-making rhythms that are lightweight enough to stay fast and rigorous enough that dependencies surface before they become problems. It's about identifying the engineering leaders who can own their domains and then creating the conditions where they can do their best work. You'll spend about two-thirds of your time on operations and people leadership. The other third stays hands-on technical. Not because we need more code reviewed, but because your technical credibility determines whether people actually trust your leadership on the hard calls. You work directly with me. The decisions you make about how the team operates will shape Socket for the next three years. This is partnership, not delegation. If you've scaled an engineering organization before, if you understand that how you build is as important as what you build, and if you want to work on something that actually matters, let's talk. What You'll Do - Scale the engineering organization from 40 to 80+ people while protecting the velocity, code quality, and culture that makes Socket work. Own two intertwined responsibilities: be the operational leader who keeps the organization unblocked and coordinated, AND be the technical leader who shapes architecture decisions and keeps the team executing with urgency. - Design an operating system that actually works. Build planning cadence, sprint structure, and decision-making processes that are lightweight enough to stay fast and rigorous enough to catch risks early. Document how Socket makes decisions so new engineers understand the culture, not just the rules. The best operating systems don't feel like bureaucracy. They feel like clarity. - Build technical leadership across the organization. Create weekly coordination rhythms so teams sync proactively. Define cle

The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. By joining our talent community, you'll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you'll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we'll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You'll Need - Native or near-native fluency in English - Based in: Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, New Zealand, UK, Malaysia, South Africa, US, Singapore - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: 📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems 🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) 🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks.
